definitions.explanation: A piece used in board games such as shogi (Japanese chess), chess, or go.
Figuratively, a person used by others for their own purposes.

examples.japanese: {将棋|しょうぎ}の{駒|こま}を{並|なら}べた。
{相手|あいて}の{駒|こま}を{取|と}った。
{彼|かれ}は{上司|じょうし}の{駒|こま}として{使|つか}われていた。
examples.english: He was being used as a pawn by his boss.

notes:
SHOGI PIECES ({将棋|しょうぎ}の{駒|こま}):
・{王将|おうしょう}/{玉将|ぎょくしょう} (king)
・{飛車|ひしゃ} (rook)
・{角行|かくぎょう} (bishop)
・{金将|きんしょう} (gold general)
・{銀将|ぎんしょう} (silver general)
・{桂馬|けいま} (knight)
・{香車|きょうしゃ} (lance)
・{歩兵|ふひょう} (pawn)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{駒|こま}を{進|すす}める (to advance a piece; to make progress)
・{駒|こま}として{使|つか}う (to use someone as a pawn)
・{持|も}ち{駒|ごま} (pieces in hand - captured pieces in shogi; also figuratively: resources at one's disposal)

NOTE: The word {駒|こま} originally meant 'horse' and is sometimes still used in this archaic sense in literary contexts.

OTHER MEANING:
・{独楽|こま} (spinning top) - written with different kanji but same pronunciation
